description: MATJAV crystallizes in the monoclinic crystal system with space group P 21/c. Reported CIF formula moiety: C47 H51 Dy2 N10 O10 1+,2(C1 H4 O1),H2 O1,Cl1 1-. From the CIF bond table, Dy1 (Dy) has 5 O neighbors; Dy2 (Dy) has 5 O neighbors. Oxygen-bridged metal-site graph: 1 pairs, 1 components; largest component is a chain with insufficient metal sites for a 3D shape classification. Computed bridged metal-metal separations span 4.034-4.034 Å (not direct metal-metal bonds). Computed M-O-M angles span 113.56-113.95°; individual values and O labels are in metal_framework.links. Article card reports molecular formula [Dy2(LH2)2(μ2-η1:η1-Piv)]Cl·2MeOH·H2O (C49H59ClDy2N10O13).
interpretation_limit: Oxidation states, nuclearity, oxo/hydroxo bridging, core charge and ligand identities/counts require article/SI or manual verification; atom-site counts are asymmetric-unit counts, not molecular stoichiometry. Graph topology is limited to identity-symmetry bonds in the CIF table. Approximate shape is based only on bridge-unwrapped metal-site coordinates in the largest component; symmetry-related bonds or periodic structures require manual crystallographic review. Empirical formulas alone do not establish unique oxidation-state assignments or ligand connectivity; annotations above reproduce explicit structural notation only.
